type get_molecular_weight = (_: {

type get_heavy_atom_count = (_: {

type get_tpsa = (_: {

type get_fraction_csp3 = (_: {

smiles: string

type get_mol_mr = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_ring_count = (_: {

smiles: string

type get_formal_charge = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_qed = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return heteroatom count (non C/H).
type get_num_heteroatoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Analyze fused ring systems (clusters of rings sharing bonds) and report their topology, aromaticity, and heteroatom content. Distinguishes fused polycyclic systems from isolated rings. // SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type classify_ionization = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string,

ph?: number
}) => any;

type compute_similarity = (_: {
// Query SMILES string.
smiles: string,
// List of reference SMILES strings to compare against.
reference_smiles: string[]
}) => any;

// SMILES string of the molecule.

type describe_high_level_fg_fragments = (_: {
// The SMILES string to parse.

// The SMILES string of the molecule. Do not pass in an ellipsis (`...`) or other abbreviation.

// Query SMILES.

smiles: string

type score_structural_alerts = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string,

alert_library?: "all" | "pains" | "pains_a" | "pains_b" | "pains_c" | "brenk" | "nih" | "zinc" | "chembl" | "chembl_bms" | "chembl_lint" | "chembl_mlsmr"
}) => any;

// Return Labute approximate surface area (ASA proxy).
type get_labute_asa = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return fraction of aromatic atoms.
type get_fraction_aromatic_atoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return heterocycle count.
type get_num_heterocycles = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return aromatic heterocycle count.
type get_num_aromatic_heterocycles = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return atom stereocenter count.
type get_num_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Bertz complexity index.
type get_bertz_ct = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Kappa1 shape index.
type get_kappa1 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_kappa2 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;
